title: Localization phase diagram of the Hexagonal Lattice with irrational magnetic flux
summary: We study the Hofstadter model on a hexagonal lattice with irrational magnetic flux in this work. The Hofstadter model of the square lattice with irrational flux has been solved mathematically by Avila and his collaborators in his Fields medal work. However, this theory is usually not applicable to lattices with internal degrees of freedom, such as spin or sublattice.
